cases.purpose: Full procps/candidate slabtop batch bytes on the identical bind-mounted fixture: batch-malformed.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c '
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind "$PWD/slabinfo" /proc/slabinfo || exit 91
/usr/bin/cmp slabinfo /proc/slabinfo || exit 92
/usr/bin/slabtop -o > "$HOME/slab-control.out" 2> "$HOME/slab-control.err"
result=$?
printf "%s\n" "$result" > "$HOME/slab-control.status"
[[ $result == 1 ]] || exit 93
[[ $(< "$HOME/slab-control.err") == *"Numerical result out of range"* ]] || exit 94
'

files.slabinfo:
slabinfo - version: 2.1
# name active_objs num_objs objsize objperslab pagesperslab : tunables limit batchcount sharedfactor : slabdata active_slabs num_slabs sharedavail

cases.oracle: The preserved independent procps qualification control rejected this malformed slabinfo with Numerical result out of range. The revised setup requires procps exit 1 and the diagnostic on the exact bind-mounted data, and retains the raw status/output. The reference body is then run independently and must match the fixed status. Procps 4.0.4 source uses EXIT_FAILURE for this initialization error: https://sources.debian.org/src/procps/2%3A4.0.4-9/src/slabtop.c/
cases.comparison: The candidate and pinned procps reference each process identical malformed slabinfo; both must return status 1, and complete stdout and stderr are compared. The setup status and error are retained; if the reference status hypothesis is wrong this is a setup error, never coverage.
